newsitem.title: UK: UK NTC consumer indicator rises again in February.
newsitem.headline: UK NTC consumer indicator rises again in February.

text.p: The NTC consumer industries' leading indicator rose in February after falls in the previous three months, NTC Economic and Financial Research said. "The upturn in the indicator in February signals the first acceleration in economic growth since last October," it said.

The upturn in February was due to strong retail sales growth in February, increased levels of optimism, continued buoyancy in stock markets, strong growth in output of consumer goods and an acceleration in the rate of growth both in vacancies advertised at job centres and TV advertising revenues.
The index was 107.70 in February compared with 107.36 in January and 103.72 in February 1996.
NTC said its indicator tended to move ahead of the economic cycle by 11 months. The higher the indicator, the faster the rate of economic growth signalled.
